user.title: RejseplanAPI — Connect
user.description: Enter the base URL of your RejseplanAPI backend (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8000). The integration will verify connectivity before continuing.

data_description.api_url: Base URL including port, without trailing slash

search.title: RejseplanAPI — Find stop
search.description: Type part of the stop name to search (e.g. "Nørreport", "Valby").

data_description.search_query: Free-text search — at least 2 characters recommended

configure_route.title: RejseplanAPI — Configure route
configure_route.description: Select the stop you want to monitor, optionally filter by line number or letter (e.g. "2A", "S"), and set how many minutes it takes you to walk to the stop.

data_description.line_filter: Leave empty to show all lines at this stop
data_description.walk_time: How many minutes does it take you to walk to the stop?

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the RejseplanAPI. Check the URL and make sure the server is running.
error.invalid_url: The URL is not valid. Make sure it starts with http:// or https://.
error.no_stops_found: No stops found for that search term. Try a different query.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.already_configured: This stop / line combination is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This stop / line combination is already configured.

init.title: RejseplanAPI — Options
init.description: Update how many minutes it takes you to walk to the stop. The "Go now" sensor will turn on when the next departure is within this time.

data_description.walk_time: Minutes from your door to the stop
